title: EOD Explosive Munitions Documentation and Disposal during Keen Sword 27
description: U.S. Marines with Marine Corps Installations Pacific Explosive Ordnance Disposal participate in an explosive munition identification and disposal training event during Exercise Keen Sword 27 on Camp Hansen, Okinawa, Japan, Oct. 23, 2026. Keen Sword is a routine, biennial bilateral field training exercise with multinational participation, designed to increase readiness and interoperability between the U.S. military and Japan Self-Defense Forces while strengthening the ironclad U.S.-Japan Alliance. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Lance Cpl. Nathan Saucier)
